title: SMPShards
description: AFK SHARDS PLUGIN FOR YOUR SMP SERVER
body:
## ShardsSMP adds shards and an afk area to your server.

**commands:**
-   /shards top - Opens the leaderboard
-   /shards shards - Shows your shards
-   /shards setpos1 - Sets position 1
-   /shards setpos2 - Sets position 2
-   /shards give <player> <amount> - Gives shards to a player
-   /shards reset <player> - Resets a player's shards
-   /shards info - Shows information about the area
-   /shards reload - Reloads the plugin
